name: External Cash Account Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the nature, or use, of the cash account in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

CACC.name: Current
CACC.definition: Account used to post debits and credits when no specific account has been nominated.

CARD.name: Card Account
CARD.definition: Account used for credit card payments.

CASH.name: Cash Payment
CASH.definition: Account used for the payment of cash.

CHAR.name: Charges
CHAR.definition: Account used for charges if different from the account for|payment.

CISH.name: Cash Income
CISH.definition: Account used for payment of income if different from the current cash account

COMM.name: Commission
COMM.definition: Account used for commission if different from the account|for payment.

CPAC.name: Clearing Participant Settlement Account
CPAC.definition: Account used to post settlement debit and credit entries on behalf of a designated Clearing Participant.

LLSV.name: Limited Liquidity Savings Account
LLSV.definition: Account used for savings with special interest and withdrawal terms.

MGLD.name: Marginal Lending
MGLD.definition: Account used for a marginal lending facility.

MOMA.name: Money Market
MOMA.definition: Account used for money markets if different from the cash|account.

SACC.name: Settlement
SACC.definition: Account used to post debit and credit entries, as a result of transactions cleared and settled through a specific clearing and settlement system.

TAXE.name: Tax
TAXE.definition: Account used for taxes if different from the account for|payment.

TRAN.name: Transacting Account
TRAN.definition: A transacting account is the most basic type of bank account that you can get. The main difference between transaction and cheque accounts is that you usually do not get a cheque book with your transacting account and neither are you offered an overdraft facility.

TRAS.name: Cash Trading
TRAS.definition: Account used for trading if different from the current cash account.

VACC.name: Virtual Account
VACC.definition: Account created virtually to facilitate collection and reconciliation.

NFCA.name: Non Resident Foreign Currency Account
NFCA.definition: Non-Resident Individual / Entity Foreign Current held domestically.

RFCA.name: Resident Individual Foreign Currency Account
RFCA.definition: Resident Individual Foreign Currency held domestically.

REFC.name: Resident Entity Foreign Currency
REFC.definition: Resident Entity Foreign Currency held domestically.

NLCY.name: Non Resident Local Domestic Currency Account

ODEP.name: Ordinary Deposit
ODEP.definition: Account used as ordinary deposit for everyday deposits and withdrawals.
